changes.detail: markRead now updates only a ticket whose flag is still set and returns true when it cleared one, false when there was nothing to clear. Opening a read ticket is no longer a write, so a change feed or table trigger watching support_tickets (live updates) no longer sees a change on every read, which made a page that marks a ticket read when it loads refetch it forever.
changes.summary: markRead writes nothing when the ticket is already read, and returns whether it changed anything

changes.detail: The first release: support_tickets, support_messages and support_events as Drizzle tables, and createSupportDesk over them: open (idempotent per submission), reply (agents' first public reply starts the response clock and waits on the requester; notes are agent-only; a requester's reply reopens), setStatus, setPriority, assign (each an event), get (with a requester view without notes or history), list with filters and paging, statusCounts, markRead and analytics (opened, resolved, unanswered, median first response and resolution, backlog by priority), with an onChange hook for emails and live signals.
changes.summary: Support tickets: a report with its context becomes a ticket, a threaded conversation with internal notes, and response-time analytics
